segments.name: Software and services
segments.description: Supplies software products and services to communications, entertainment and media service providers, covering customer experience, billing, networking, data and managed services.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as one operating segment, providing software products and services primarily for the communications, and media industry service providers.

revenueModel.text: Communications, entertainment and media service providers pay for software products and related services, including managed services, systems integration, consulting and ongoing maintenance and support.
revenueModel.evidence: Amdocs is a leading provider of software and services for approximately 400 communications, entertainment and media industry and other service providers in developed countries and emerging markets.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2025 the company phased out several low-margin, non-core business activities.
changes.evidence: During the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, the Company phased out several low-margin, non-core business activities, which were included in fiscal year 2024.
